task: R0 task 1.1 — machine-readable per-frontend 65-RPC action inventory
audit_method: Read-only source inspection. Each of the 31 ColimaService + 34 DockerService RPCs was checked against (a) its concrete daemon server receiver method, (b) the generated client method, and (c) each frontend's handler. Exactly one coverage cell is emitted per (RPC, frontend). Evidence levels are the strongest level substantiated by source + green CI (frontends.yml 9/9) + recorded live desktop-e2e evidence; live-backend is never fabricated.
schema_v2_migration_note: Reconciled from schema_version 1 (260 verbose records). The flat per-(RPC,frontend) coverage cells are preserved (now under `cells`, matching the design EvidenceCell model {rpc, frontend, server_implemented, frontend_handler, evidence_level}); the required taxonomy `evidence_level` field was ADDED to every cell; repeated per-frontend prose was de-duplicated into `frontend_evidence_notes`; per-cell `note` retained only for non-generic cases. Two stale cells were corrected (see audit_findings).

evidence_taxonomy.source-only: The concrete daemon server method exists in source, but this frontend has NO handler for the RPC (server-side-only coverage). In this inventory every source-only cell is a missing-frontend-handler cell, because all 65 RPCs have a concrete server method.
evidence_taxonomy.deterministic-fake-data: Frontend renders/behaves correctly against fakeDS/deterministic fixtures (unit/integration/snapshot). Not fabricated live proof. Not used as a top level for any cell here because every handler-present frontend also passes green native CI (a strictly stronger level).
evidence_taxonomy.CI-without-daemon: The frontend containing this handler compiles and passes its test suite on a native CI runner without a live daemon (frontends.yml 9/9 + test.yml green). NOTE: this asserts the frontend+suite are green in CI, not that every RPC has a dedicated per-RPC test.
evidence_taxonomy.live-backend: Verified against a live Colima daemon on the disposable desktop-e2e profile (macOS RealBackend service lane / live exercise; TUI live Unix+loopback-TCP daemon action). Only level that closes a live-verification obligation.
evidence_taxonomy.environment-blocked: A live UIA (Windows) / AT-SPI (Linux) UI capture could not run on the macOS-only host. Recorded honestly, never counted as success. In THIS inventory (per-RPC handler coverage) no cell is environment-blocked: Windows/Linux handler coverage is proven via green native CI = CI-without-daemon, and their live UI-capture obligation is tracked separately in exploration/{windows,linux} ground-truth (task 10.7). This is why Windows/Linux evidence is capped at CI-without-daemon.

evidence_level_assignment_rules: 1. live-backend: cell has recorded real desktop-e2e daemon evidence (macOS RealBackend service lane for 24 RPCs; TUI InspectImage/RemoveImage live Unix+TCP action).

2. CI-without-daemon: handler present and the frontend's suite compiles+passes on its green native CI job (macos-kit, windows-winui, linux-gtk4, daemon x3, tui x3) without a live daemon, and no live evidence recorded.
3. source-only: no frontend handler for the RPC (only the concrete server method exists).
4. frontend_handler == (evidence_level != 'source-only') for this audit, since every RPC has a concrete server method and the only reason a cell is server-side-only is an absent frontend handler.

server.note: PullImage and PushImage server handlers stream real Docker progress (focused stream success/error/cancellation/cleanup tests). Pre-v1 additive scope fields verified in proto: Update(ProfileRequest); PruneRequest.profile; host+wsl2 on Rename/Tag/Search/NetworkContainer requests and on DockerScope/IdRequest/NameRequest/ContainerActionRequest/CreateContainerRequest.

frontend_evidence_notes.macos: Native SwiftUI frontend on the host. Uses a CLI-shelling DaemonClient + Docker-API DockerClient (not gRPC). Deterministic unit/integration/snapshot lanes + the green macos-kit CI job establish CI-without-daemon for all 61 handlers; 24 RPCs additionally carry real desktop-e2e live-backend evidence from the RealBackend service lane. This inventory does not assert one dedicated test per RPC.
frontend_evidence_notes.windows: WinUI 3 frontend. 65/65 RPCs mapped to view-model command handlers (windows/RPC_AUDIT.md). Cannot build on the macOS host; parity proven via the green windows-winui CI job + 22 headless deterministic service/view-model tests (CI-without-daemon). Live WinUI UIA capture and local-WSL2/remote-SSH action proof are environment-blocked on this host (tracked in exploration/windows ground-truth, task 10.7); RPC evidence capped at CI-without-daemon.
frontend_evidence_notes.linux: GTK4/Rust frontend. 65/65 RPCs invoked by GTK callbacks on the GLib main context via the generated tonic client. Parity proven via the green linux-gtk4 CI job + Ubuntu VM fmt/clippy(-D warnings)/9 tests/release build (CI-without-daemon). Live AT-SPI capture and nested-VM Docker mutation are environment-blocked on this host (tracked in exploration/linux ground-truth, task 10.7); RPC evidence capped at CI-without-daemon.
frontend_evidence_notes.tui: Bubble Tea/Go frontend. 61/65 RPCs wired (typed action dispatch + client reads). Green daemon/tui CI jobs + deterministic 12-surface PTY validation establish CI-without-daemon; InspectImage and RemoveImage additionally carry live desktop-e2e Unix/loopback-TCP evidence.

audit_findings: CONFIRMED (Property 7, server side): all 65 RPCs (31 ColimaService + 34 DockerService) have a concrete, non-Unimplemented daemon server receiver. No RPC lacks a server method.

CORRECTION (Requirement 1.3): GetTemplate:macos and SetTemplate:macos were recorded handler-present in schema v1. Source inspection (Sources/Services/DaemonClient.swift + ServiceProvider.swift) shows the macOS client exposes readConfig/writeConfig (GetConfig/SetConfig) only and explicitly avoids colima templates (comment: 'NEVER use colima template'). No macOS GetTemplate/SetTemplate handler exists; R5 task 7.1 will build the template UI. Reclassified to frontend_handler=false / source-only. macOS handler count corrected 63 -> 61.

CONFIRMED macOS gaps: VMStats (Monitoring uses native resource data; no VMStats stream handler) and PushImage (pushImage() throws ServiceProviderError.unsupported; no functional push handler). Both source-only.

CONFIRMED TUI gaps (61/65): Version (no client/action handler) and StreamEvents/StreamLogs/StreamStats (continuous Docker stream modes not exposed by the TUI action client). Both note that VMStats IS wired on the TUI via a bounded single-sample read (client.VMStats).

CONFIRMED Windows 65/65 (windows/RPC_AUDIT.md maps every RPC to a view-model command handler) and Linux 65/65 (generated tonic client + verified GTK callbacks incl. VMStats poll and StreamLogs/StreamStats in monitoring.rs/containers.rs). Both capped at CI-without-daemon; live UIA/AT-SPI capture is environment-blocked on the macOS-only host.

CONFIRMED pre-v1 additive scope fields in proto/colima_ui.proto (Update takes ProfileRequest; PruneRequest.profile; host+wsl2 on Rename/Tag/Search/NetworkContainer). Windows records that its 5 provider-scope RPCs (RenameContainer, TagImage, SearchImages, ConnectNetwork, DisconnectNetwork) plus Update/Prune reject unsafe remote/WSL2/global selection with an actionable error rather than silently targeting local/global state — handlers are present.
